server: Web research tools for agents, built on Mastra and Jev (TypeSafe's decision model): search, read, crawl, extract, and watch web pages, with typed inputs and capped output. TYPESAFE_API_KEY lets Jev make the judgment calls; with no key, rules decide.

tools.search: Search the web, Wikipedia, Hacker News, or arXiv, with no API key. Returns titles, URLs, and snippets.
tools.scrape: Read one web page by URL as clean Markdown, without menus or ads. For two or more URLs, use batch. Returns the title and Markdown.
tools.map: List a site's URLs from its sitemap and links, to see its pages before you scrape. Returns the URLs.
tools.summarize: Pick the key sentences of a text or page, with no model call. Returns them verbatim with offsets and the page read.
tools.crawl: Visit a page and the pages it links to, up to a depth and page limit. Returns each page's URL and Markdown.
tools.extract: Get named parts of a page by CSS selector, like a price. Pass fields as name:selector pairs, or one selector. Returns the matched text.
tools.answer: Answer a question from a few web sources, with no model call. Pass urls to read only those pages, with no search. Returns the key sentences and their source URLs.
tools.research: Research a topic across many web sources in one call. When asked to research a topic, use it, not search then scrape. Returns key points with their source URLs.
tools.jev: Improve webular's Jev calls: action learn tests lessons on recorded calls; action correct labels one recorded call (id) with the right answer (label), optionally with an input file.
tools.parse: Turn a local file on disk, like a PDF or HTML file, into clean text. Returns the text.
tools.media: Save a page's media to a file: download it, screenshot it, or print a PDF. Returns the saved path and size.
tools.monitor: Check a page for changes since the last check. Returns whether and what it changed.
tools.batch: Read two or more URLs in one call, not one scrape per URL. Returns one result per URL, each marked ok or not.
tools.act: Read a page in a real browser, for pages that need JavaScript, with an optional screenshot. Returns the page text. Or pass goal instead of url to act in the Cua window named by WEBULAR_CUA_WINDOW. It returns status (done or infeasible), at (the step it could not reach), and rungs (how each step was clicked: ax, ocr, or pixel).
tools.feed: Read an RSS or Atom feed's newest posts. Returns each item's title, link, and date.
tools.doctor: Check that webular can run here, when a tool fails for no clear reason. Returns each check, pass or fail, and a note.
tools.tasks: List the mise tasks that build, check, and run webular. Returns the task names and count.
tools.diagram: List the XState machines that model how webular commands run. Returns the machine names and count.
tools.audit: Check whether deepsec is installed and show the security scan plan, with no API key. Returns whether it is ready and the command to run.

titles.answer: Answer a question from the web
titles.media: Save page media to a file
titles.act: Open a page in a browser
